results.title: Stop Signs
results.overview: Moments after Thalia is sexually assaulted, she spends the afternoon with a friend. The world she once knew looks completely different to her now.

results.title: The Life of Rose
results.overview: After a phone call with her grandmother, a granddaughter returns home for the holidays. Through their intimate conversations, two generations explore different perspectives on life, death, and what it means to cherish the time we have.

results.title: Being Ben
results.overview: With his NBA career getting a restart this season with the Sacramento Kings, former No. 1 draft pick Ben Simmons opens up in a new ESPN E60 documentary about the highs and lows of his extraordinary career, his attempt to reclaim his place in the game – and his lifelong passion for fishing.

results.title: Where the Fear Ends
results.overview: In 1976 a small group of women in Montgomery County, PA sat together around a kitchen table to discuss the Women’s Movement. They were aware of women wanting to enter the workforce, go to college, and create ways to balance all of it with their roles as wives and mothers. They thought it might be a good idea to set up a women’s resource group and have a place that women could come to discuss ideas and receive support. Then the hotline started ringing. Volunteers answered the calls. And the calls kept coming. The majority of calls were from women sharing that they were being abused by their partners and they needed help. The Volunteers were shocked and sprang into action to build an organization that addressed the needs of domestic violence victims.  Fifty years later the Women's Center of Montgomery County has grown into a thriving organization with seven offices and more than 150 Volunteers and one of the most effective domestic violence organizations in the country.

results.title: Shark Lake
results.overview: A couple travel to a remote hotel hoping to repair their relationship, only to discover that the mysterious owner is hiding a deadly secret involving his hungry pet shark, Cinnamon.

results.title: Undercover: A Year in Reform
results.overview: Undercover filming of senior Reform politicians and officials working at its UK headquarters, and politicians campaigning for the party across Britain.

results.title: Choke On This
results.overview: A lonely competitive eater turns to a condescending mentor to push him to his absolute limit for a hot dog eating contest.

results.title: A Family Affair
results.overview: A writer is forced to confront her estranged family and past memories of a missing best friend during a visit to her aunt's house.

results.title: The Awake
results.overview: Mike wakes up one morning to find that the tattoos covering his entire body have mysteriously vanished. But that impossible event is only the beginning. With every new awakening, reality becomes increasingly unstable, forcing Mike to question his memories, his identity, and whether the life he remembers ever truly existed. As the line between nightmare and reality dissolves, he must uncover the truth before he loses himself and put the entire world in danger.

results.title: The Tide
results.overview: After a devastating breakup, a woman follows a mysterious figure into the fog on a remote Nova Scotia beach, plunging into a supernatural nightmare the ocean won’t let her escape.

results.title: Goruden Awa
results.overview: The sun is forever setting in Tokyo and Taro leaves the city behind. In the dark hour far away, he walks without arrival. Through nightly deserted villages, fields and forests, his phone lights the way, as wandering becomes plot and the landscape a space of projection.

results.title: A Shitty Smile
results.overview: At a red light, two strangers confess their darkest secrets through their car windows before the light turns green.

results.title: Seduced by an Amish Stranger
results.overview: A handsome young man arrives in an Amish community claiming to be homeless. He's taken in and treated with particular kindness by a widowed mother, but she soon discovers he isn't who he claims to be.

results.title: La linea dell’orizzonte
results.overview: This documentary offers a rare, intimate portrait of renowned artist Tullio Pericoli. Filmed patiently over a long period, the film captures him sketching landscapes and human faces, bridging artistic traditions from the Renaissance to the modern era. Blending art, memory, and autobiography, it traces his journey from a young dreamer arriving in 1960s Milan to an intensely private master of his craft.

results.title: Lesya Ukrainka's Pleyada
results.overview: At the tail end of the 19th century, a young up-and-coming composer and author named Larysa Petrivna Kosach Kvitka decides to take her amateur writing to the next level, and, along with a group of like-minded individuals forms the Pleiada Literary Association and takes on a new name: Lesya Ukrainka.

results.title: Traqueteo
results.overview: I look around and observe the landscape. I let myself go because that's all I have left: to listen, to look, to sleep, perhaps to dream. The rattle of the bus moves me.

results.title: The Lost Princess of Hackney
results.overview: A self-proclaimed Elvish Princess finds herself stranded on our world in the Hackney Marshes. Without any magic to return home, she searches for purpose but develops an unlikely friendship with a sceptical student filmmaker.

results.title: Blue
results.overview: Narrated by Marco Baliani, Blu takes viewers on a journey along Italy's coastlines and seabeds, blending mythology, history, and marine science. Through breathtaking imagery, the documentary contrasts the sea's timeless beauty with the urgent environmental threats it faces today, issuing a poignant call for ecological awareness and preservation.
